Data input for the assessment

Catch Data

  • Catch-at-age data since 1985
  • plus group 5
  • fbar at 2 - 4

CPUE Data

  • Six standardized CPUE series

    • Greek longliners since 1987
    • Moroccan longliners since 2012
    • Spanish longliners since 1988
    • Ligurian longliners since 2010
    • Sicilian longliners from 1991 to 2009
    • Ligurian surface longliners 1991 to 2009

  • Representative of age groups 2 - 4

CPUE indices

Final runs

  • Two final runs were considered:

    • one with constant M
    • one with constant M including estimated Discards

  • Models specifications kept the same:

    • for \(F\), \(R\), \(\mathbf{\sigma^2}\), \(\tau^{2}_{s}\) and \(N_{1}\)

    • Q model altered according to the new CPUE index:

\[ Q : \begin{cases} \sim 1, &\quad \text{Greek longline}\\ \sim 1, &\quad \text{Spanish longline}\\ \sim s(year, k=3), &\quad \text{Moroccan longline}\\ \sim s(year, k=3), &\quad \text{Ligurian longline}\\ \sim 1, &\quad \text{Sicilian longline}\\ \sim s(year, k=9), &\quad \text{Ligurian surface longline}\\ \end{cases} \]
